# Assets · Logos

6 files under `assets/Logos/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for icyre-lockup-holo.svg>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

ICYRE brand marks. `icyre-lockup-holo` for the sidebar and splash on light grounds; `icyre-lockup-ink` on imagery or print; `icyre-symbol-holo` ≥ 20px, `icyre-symbol-ink` below 20px and for favicons; `icyre-wordmark` is always ink `#141821`; `icyre-app-icon` for home screens and app stores (ink symbol on the iridescent-primary pastel). Clear space: one symbol width. Never recolor, outline or retype the wordmark.
